_comment: OpenAI Function Calling / Codex tool definitions for RedLog. Use these with any OpenAI-API-compatible model or agent framework.

function.name: redlog_mark
function.description: Create a timestamped marker in the RedLog attack timeline. Use when you discover a vulnerability, start a new testing phase, or want to note something important.

notes.description: Additional context, reproduction steps, or technical details

target.description: Target host, IP, or URL this relates to

function.name: redlog_log_event
function.description: Log a structured event to the RedLog timeline. Prefer standard agent_type (shell, agent, scanner, dns, credential_use, c2_checkin, file_transfer, marker, loot) and standard data keys (subtype, command, tool, dest_ip, dest_host, dest_port, user_context, mitre_ttp, description, sha256, bytes). See docs/event-schema.md.

agent_type.description: Event source category. Prefer: shell / agent / scanner / dns / credential_use / c2_checkin / file_transfer / marker / loot

data.description: Event payload. Populate standard keys when applicable.

function.name: redlog_search
function.description: Search across all RedLog events (shell commands, targets, clipboard, loot) by keyword.

function.name: redlog_status
function.description: Get the current RedLog status including IP/VPN state, event count, scope violations, and recording state.

function.name: redlog_scope
function.description: Get the current scope configuration: in-scope targets, exclusions, and any scope violations detected.

function.name: redlog_loot_scan
function.description: Scan text for credentials, secrets, API keys, JWTs, password hashes, private keys, database URLs, and CTF flags.

text.description: Text to scan for embedded secrets or credentials

function.name: redlog_quickmark
function.description: Create a QuickMark bookmark for a URL, finding, or point of interest.

note.description: Notes about why this is interesting

function.name: redlog_screenshot
function.description: Capture a screenshot of the current desktop state.

function.name: redlog_whoami
function.description: Return the operator identity this API token resolves to. Call once at session start to confirm your events are being attributed correctly.

function.name: redlog_operators_list
function.description: List every operator token registered on this RedLog instance.

function.name: redlog_chain_status
function.description: Return evidence-chain length plus the latest OpenTimestamps anchor status (complete/partial/failed/pending).

function.name: redlog_chain_anchor_now
function.description: Submit the current chain head to public OpenTimestamps calendars immediately. Use before ending a session or right after a critical finding to lock its timestamp into the Bitcoin blockchain via OTS.

function.name: redlog_chain_verify
function.description: Fast integrity check: confirm the latest anchor still describes a prefix of the current event chain.

function.name: redlog_chain_upgrade
function.description: Fetch upgraded OpenTimestamps proofs from calendars for pending anchors. Wait at least a few hours after anchoring; the calendar has to fold your digest into a Bitcoin-anchored Merkle tree first. Omit anchor_id to upgrade all pending anchors.

anchor_id.description: Specific anchor id. Omit to upgrade all pending.
